entities.summary: Miloslav Šimek was a Czech comedian and satirist. He was most famous for his double act with Jiří Grossmann on their show Návštěvní den at the Semafor, presented in 1968–1971. Later he cooperated with Luděk Sobota, Petr Nárožný, Jiří Krampol, and finally Zuzana Bubílková.

entities.summary: Miloslav Šimek was a Czech comedian and satirist. He was most famous for his double act with Jiří Grossmann on their show Návštěvní den at the Semafor, presented in 1968–1971. Later he cooperated with Luděk Sobota, Petr Nárožný, Jiří Krampol, and finally Zuzana Bubílková.
